text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—The type you'd want as a lover?!
City's talking about romance?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, it's about work.
For a magazine survey.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I couldn't think of anything, though... So I was wondering how the two of you would answer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I see~. But isn't that a total cliché?
Feels like City's probably used to answering that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I just gave vague answers.
Like, 'I'm crazy about racing right now'... or something.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: “Still, some girls are taking it seriously as reference, so I feel like I gotta give a proper answer.”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously way too serious, y'know?
...Lovers, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, pick me!
I've already got an idea☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hype, party-hard,
god-tier good-vibes peeps reign supreme!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that just Helios?
You a narcissist or somethin'?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna hype myself up~☆
Besides, it doesn't really have to be "me"-ish!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yin, yang, none of that matters!
If the two of us become invincible together, that's pure love, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, maybe it's that!
Maybe I'm just in love with all of humanity~☆"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Not sure if 'impressive' is the word,
but she's on a whole other level...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This is zero help at all.
...Ah, my nail polish is chipping.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My type, huh? Personally,
I like 'em cool, maybe a bit on the assertive side~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?
Doesn't it piss you off when people talk down to you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, hardcore aggressive types are totally not my thing~,
and I'd hate dealing with crazy stuff like sudden kicks, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it? People who act all aggro,
they're actually kinda sensitive, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, when you see someone trying their best to look cool,
it's like... total heart-throb! Y'know?”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... So that's a thing too, huh.
Guess everyone thinks about this stuff more than I realized.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, this is just going with the flow of the moment.
Why don't you try keeping it light and breezy too, City?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
Ah, I just thought of something.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Someone stronger than me.
Physical or mental, if they can't beat me,
they're not even worth talking to.

text_block_list.name: Jordan & Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's so City, lol.
Anyway, aren't you starved?
Let's hit the commissary~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyyy~â
Time to celebrate the birth of City's new store-cup crush~!
